name: DeltaNet
notes: Qwen3.5 / Qwen3-Next Gated DeltaNet (gated delta-rule, per-head scalar log-decay) NKI kernels, vendored verbatim under gdn_src/ (Apache-2.0 per source repo README; see ./NOTICE) from HF kernels/jburtoft/qwen35-deltanet-tkg-full (v4). This is the PERF path replacing the reference-torch chunk_gated_delta_rule. Shape dispatch (adapter:build_gdn_forward): S==1 & cached -> deltanet_tkg_batched_bh (decode); S>=128 & S%128==0 -> deltanet_fused_chunked_fwd_batched (prefill perf, needs lower/identity/lower_diag masks built in-adapter); S<128 -> deltanet_recurrent_fwd[_state] (per-slice loop). Constraints: head_dim==128, gate per-head scalar log-decay<=0, chunk multiple 128, fp32, no group axis (GQA expanded before kernel). On-device validated on trn2 (nki 0.6.0): out cos 1.0 (chunked max_err ~3e-7, tkg ~1.5e-5), final_state cos 1.0. Injected via backends.kernel_inject. Harvest identity: 'GatedDeltaNet'. PERF (2026-08-28): the chunked-prefill branch has a DEVICE FAST-PATH — when inputs are torch tensors already on a Neuron device it calls the @nki.jit kernel DIRECTLY (do NOT round-trip through host numpy, which runs nki's sim/recompile route). Steady-state 2.8ms vs ~3500ms for the numpy path (~1250x), byte-identical output (cos 1.0). Verified on trn2: kernel is genuinely compiler-weak — 22.75x faster than the torch naive recurrence at BH8/S512 (device-timed), and the recurrence's graph is compile-intractable at S=2048. GOTCHA: these kernels are already @nki.jit — call directly on device tensors; do NOT wrap with torch_neuronx.nki_jit or use nki.benchmark (both fail 'Kernel has no attribute grid').
